why_declared_first: Thresholds chosen after seeing the candidate distribution would be a way of choosing the target while appearing not to. They are fixed here, the pool is computed once, and the result is accepted whatever it is.

thresholds.why_40_not_25: Rule 4 requires >=25 distinct CLINICAL-STAGE assets. The snapshot carries no phase field, so distinct-drug count is a proxy that also includes preclinical, withdrawn and tool compounds. 40 is a deliberate margin on the 25 floor. The true clinical-stage count is verified after selection and before any engine run; a rule-4 failure at that point triggers a redraw from the same frozen pool, which the proposal already permits.
thresholds.mab_test: canonical drug name ends in 'mab' (case-insensitive), the INN stem for monoclonal antibodies
thresholds.why_mab_fraction: Rule 2 requires a different modality class from the antibody-dominated M8-M12 work. A target whose drug set is mostly -mab is antibody-centric and is excluded mechanically, without my naming any target.

rule_1_note: The proposal's named exclusions plus the adjacent co-stimulatory/checkpoint set, which shares the immuno-oncology checkpoint literature and would let PDCD1-era vocabulary transfer.

rule_6_prior_contact_test.method: case-insensitive word-boundary search for the target symbol across source, test, documentation, configuration and benchmark-definition files in the bve-b8 repo tree and the pdcd1_baseline staging tree, excluding .git, the ontology snapshot, and replay result/corpus artifacts
rule_6_prior_contact_test.amendment_reason: The first formulation searched every file including the 150-210 MB replay results. That is both impractical and wrong: a symbol occurring in a B8 replay OUTPUT is not prior contact in the sense rule 6 means. Rule 6 excludes targets that shaped the system -- worked examples, test fixtures, seeds, tuning cases -- and an output the engine happened to emit shaped nothing. Amended before any rule-6 result was computed or observed: the first attempt was stopped having produced no output, so the amendment cannot have been informed by which candidates it would affect.
rule_6_prior_contact_test.action_on_hit: discard the candidate from the pool; do not patch it

rule_3_status: NOT ENFORCED AT POOL STAGE. Therapeutic area is not mechanically derivable from the snapshot, and the proposal states rule 3 as 'if possible' rather than as a hard filter. The selected target's TA is recorded after selection, and if it is oncology that is reported as a weaker generalization claim rather than grounds for a redraw.

selection_method.algorithm: sort pool by canonical_target_id; seed a Mersenne Twister with the integer value of the sha256 of the frozen pool file; draw one element with random.choice
selection_method.seed_derivation: sha256 of m13_candidate_pool.json, the pool file itself
selection_method.why_this_seed: Commit-then-reveal. The seed is a function of the pool, so it cannot be shopped for after the pool is known, and any third party can recompute the same draw from the committed file. A seed I chose by hand after seeing the pool would be indistinguishable from picking the target.
selection_method.result_is_binding: The first draw is the benchmark. No redraw except on a mechanically verified rule-4 failure, and no redraw on any performance-related ground.

prohibited: inspecting candidate-specific engine performance before selection
running any target-specific query before the selection artifact is hashed
adding target-specific synonyms or hand-mapping assets at any point in M13
